g.text: Weather forecast recalibration • reproducible experiments • reviewed releases • observable serving
Training runs as Kubernetes Jobs / CronJobs; scheduling is enabled deliberately. Model promotion remains explicit.
Application release: immutable image tag + reviewed Helm values. Model release: an independently approved numeric version.
SQLite on EBS → run / registry data
Runtime reads ECR images and the pinned MLflow model. Observation verification scores the exact served artifact.

ADDITIONAL DEMONSTRATED ENVIRONMENTS / SEPARATE FROM THE CORE AWS k3s PATH
